name: Bellatrix vom Norden

photo.caption: Bellatrix (far right) with her littermates, 4 weeks old

facts.label: Parents
facts.value: Ivo vom Hafen x Aurora vom Norden

bio: Bellatrix is a beautiful reverse brindle puppy from Aurora's first litter by Ivo vom Hafen (on far right in the

picture of the litter at 4 weeks of age as well as the picture of them nursing where she has a dark blue collar). Aurora's father Cliff vom Grand Kevin was a Police K9 so Police K9s on both sides of her pedigree. Bellatrix' genetic testing so far shows her as DM clear and heterozygous brindle, meaning she has one allele for the dominant brindle color as well as a recessive fawn allele, so if bred to a male who also has at least one fawn allele she can have fawn offspring as well as brindle.  She is developing a good, stable temperament, currently learning basic obedience and manners, will begin IGP and Agility training soon.  The plan is to breed her for the first time in 2028 if she passes remaining health testing (OFA heart, hips and ARVC) and earns at least a CGC title.
